passage.label: O mankind what deceived you concerning Lord Generous; created proportioned balanced you; whatever form willed assembled you; No deny Recompense; indeed appointed over keepers; noble recording; know whatever do

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ
فِيٓ أَيِّ صُورَةٖ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ

mainSubject.label: Mankind questioned about what deceived them concerning their Generous Lord who created, proportioned and balanced them, assembling them in whatever form He willed; their denial of the Recompense answered by the appointment of noble recording keepers who know whatever they do

subordinateSubjects.label: Mankind questioned about what deceived them concerning their Generous Lord

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Deception concerning the Generous Lord despite creation, proportioning and balancing
Denial of the Recompense despite appointed recording keepers

relationships.label: Form assembled according to divine will rather than human choice
Noble recording keepers knowing every deed

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the soul-knowing verdict (5) before the deception-question opens (6); P2 ends with the recording-keepers' knowledge (12) before the two-outcome block begins (13); P3 runs through pleasure-versus-Hellfire, the doubled Day-of-Recompense question and the closing absolute-sovereignty statement (13-19).
